title: Research: bound selected-word coordinate frame rails
body:
## Result

This package studies one temporal frame-schedule mechanism on the exact selected PR1094 local word: inject a coordinate 2-plane at one helper-helper A/B gate and propagate the least common-frame closure, preserving the scalar program, start frames, all 112 target levels, all eight A/B centre frames, and every final target and dirty-helper endpoint.

The finite search covers 36 coordinate planes and all 2,525 eligible gates (90,900 pairs). It finds 569 no-ops, 89,737 exact interface or endpoint conflicts, and 594 valid schedules across 13 rank profiles. Exact ceiling intervals show the best profile is exactly the selected baseline profile `{1:2412, 2:418, 3:432, 4:142, 5:82, 8:8}`, with the same bracket `[1690054109/10^12, 169005411/10^11]`; none clears the task's 5% gate. This is a bounded negative result. It claims no new κ, global impossibility, or supplier admission.

## Verification

- `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-frame-plane-rail-seedca04cc --check-only`
- `python3 -B research/complex-frame-plane-rail-seedca04cc/verify.py`
- Expected replay output: `PASS_FRAME_RAIL_FINITE_SEARCH_NATIVE_AUDIT_AND_NEGATIVE_CONTROL`
- The replay re-enumerates the full finite domain, compares exact evidence, independently audits the committed candidate, then confirms the native auditor rejects a deliberately corrupted paid-profile claim.

The candidate also passes the pinned `gauge44-slots/independent/audit_local.py` exact native audit. Local replay used Python 3.14.7; the registered package manifest declares Python 3.12 for the repository's generic CI runner, which is not installed on the local host.

## Scope, sources, and limitations

The archive/member hashes, selected-record hash, priority revision, catalogue, and exact base commit are recorded in the package. An initial exploratory sweep omitted the internal A/B barriers and failed the native audit; all counts from it were discarded. The packaged search enforces those barriers throughout.

Adjacent open PR #1186 provides a frame solver and delivery-rewrite search for the older PR #1148 joint-entrance k8 word. This contribution instead enumerates a specific forced coordinate-plane closure family on the selected PR1094 word and supplies exact evidence that this family does not improve the ceiling. It does not repeat that solver or its construction.

Predecessors include selected provider PR #1094, frame-coalescence PR #699, fixed late-block optimum PR #1429, and cross-block interface floor PR #1517. OpenAI Codex designed and implemented the bounded search and package; attribution and source pins are included in the package.
